sm-summit-l1-q1: Dad, what should I give Grandma for her birthday? Some flowers?
She's got lots of flowers in her garden. What about some green tea? She loves tea.
Aunt Hoa always gives her tea! But Grandma's always cold in the evenings.
Then a warm scarf is perfect.
Yes! A blue one. Blue is her favourite colour.
sm-summit-l1-q2: Mum, does the lantern parade start at half past six?
No, half past six is when they give out the lanterns at the park gate. The parade starts at seven o'clock.
Can we get there early? I want a red lantern.
Yes, we'll be at the gate at half past six. And the parade finishes at half past seven.
sm-summit-l1-q3: Mum, why isn't my brother at school today? Has he got a fever again?
No, he isn't hot at all. He's got earache. He couldn't sleep last night.
Oh no. Is it because of his cough?
Maybe. His cough is much better now, but the doctor is going to look at his ear this afternoon.
sm-summit-l1-q4: Yusuf, are you going to the school party as a pirate again?
No, I was a pirate last year. I wanted to be an astronaut, but the costume was too small.
Oh no! So what are you wearing?
My cousin's green dinosaur costume. It's got a long tail!
sm-summit-l1-q5: Dad, look at that big mango cake! How much is it?
No, that sign is for the chocolate cake. The mango one is ten pounds.
You're right. And the small mango cakes are eight pounds. But let's get the big one for the party.
sm-summit-l2: Good morning, everyone. Next week our class is having a lantern-making afternoon in the school hall. It's on Thursday the eighteenth of September. We'll start at quarter past two, straight after lunch. Last year, everyone made a moon lantern. This year, you can choose. You can make a star or a fish. The fish lanterns are a bit harder, but they look lovely! We've got lots of coloured paper and glue, so you don't need to bring those. But please bring scissors and an old newspaper to keep the tables clean. At four o'clock, we'll stop for a snack. Then at half past four, we'll turn on the little lights inside and walk round the playground. Your parents can watch from the gate. The afternoon costs three pounds. That pays for the sticks and the lights. Please bring the money by Monday. Thank you!
sm-summit-l3: Hi, Tam! Did you have a nice weekend?
Yes! My cousin got married on Saturday.
Was the wedding in a big hotel?
That's what I expected, but it was in my uncle's garden.
Lovely! Did your mum and dad go with you?
Mum had to work, so I went with Dad and Grandma.
Yes, a new suit. But I didn't want to wear the jacket. It was so hot!
Was it too small? My brother's jacket was too small at our aunt's party.
No, it fitted me. Dad said I could take it off after the photos.
What was the best part? The food?
The food was delicious, and the dancing was even more fun. But the fireworks at the end were the best!
Will you see your cousin again soon?
Yes. Last week we helped her choose flowers. We were going to watch the wedding video next Sunday, but it isn't ready. So she's bringing her photos to our house instead.
